groups.name: partial_register_returns

patches.description: MOV AL,BL -> MOV EAX,EBX to eliminate CONCAT31/undefined3 in return value

patches.description: MOV AL,BL -> MOV EAX,EBX to eliminate CONCAT31/undefined3 in return value

groups.name: partial_register_reads

patches.name: loadCameraThumbnail: palette byte read G channel

groups.name: partial_register_loop_temps

patches.name: CGame_processCheatCodes: history shift loop AL->CL
